_doc: Video template library. One template = one visual world for a whole video. Read by outsider-inside-frame/tools/variety.mjs (pick, check) and tools/world.mjs. Decision: Dr. Aksoy, 2026-11-07, each video gets its own visual language. Non-negotiable in every world: see 'universal'. Worlds were written for this library; the 'sources' entries name the catalog items or repos that inspired them, no code was copied.
universal: facts.mjs verify: every number, finding, verdict and citation on screen is sourced
legibility.mjs: no text under 40 px @1080, Shorts UI zones and caption band free
compliance F1-F16 of 02-compliance-checklist; no brand, clinic or hospital logo
embryo, gamete, ultrasound, microscope and lab images are real footage only
every AI or stock clip carries its illustration tab; real footage its footage tab
video opens on Dr. Aksoy full frame; no channel intro or bumper; no end-screen graphic
face budget <= 40 %, no talking-only stretch over 45 s, no burned-in subtitles on 16:9, pop-up captions on Shorts
closing sentence of the channel word for word

outsider-inside.feel: paper, ink, one red pen (the original look)

milimetrik-gece.feel: dark graph paper, measured grid, cool glow

gazete.feel: print editorial page, heavy serif, halftone

isvicre.feel: strict grid, flush-left grotesque, one colour, hard cuts

afis.feel: colour-block poster, giant condensed type, slams

kolaj.feel: cut paper on kraft, stepped stop-motion time

lab-hud.feel: instrument read-out, brackets, typed-on mono text

cam.feel: keynote look: mesh gradient, frosted glass, soft glow

sinema.feel: letterbox, film grain, warm light leak, slow serif

pastel.feel: warm rounded cards, soft discs, gentle spring
